Post Text:
Hello everyone 

I am looking for a reliable long-term supplier or manufacturer for a new children?s and family activity blanket product.

I need **coloring blankets** that can be used both as a creative coloring activity and as comfortable everyday blankets. The blankets should be soft, good quality, not too heavy, and available in different sizes for both children and adults.

The most important requirement is the fabric. I need your professional help selecting a suitable fabric that works well with **both types of markers**:
1. **Water-based washable markers** - the colors should wash out of the blanket so it can be colored again.
2. **Permanent fabric markers** - the colors should remain permanently after washing when the customer wants to preserve the finished artwork.

The top/front side must be **plain white, smooth, soft and suitable for coloring and printing**. It should not be too fluffy or have long fibers, because children and adults need to color the printed designs easily and accurately. The marker ink should not easily bleed through the blanket or transfer onto skin, clothing, beds, sofas or other furniture during normal use.

I am interested in several blanket options:

? A thin, lightweight double-layer blanket
? A soft, slightly warm double-layer blanket for everyday use
? A warmer double-layer winter blanket

The front/top side should always be white. If possible, I would like the back side to be available in different colors. Please send me the available colors, fabrics, GSM weights and photos or videos of each option.

A very important advantage would be if you can also provide **custom printing using my own original black-and-white designs**. I do not need ready-made stock designs. I want to use only artwork supplied by me.

The printed black outlines must be clear, sharp, durable and washable. Please explain which printing method you recommend for this product and whether the black printed design will remain permanent after repeated washing.

I also need high-quality marker sets:

? Non-toxic, water-based washable marker sets suitable for coloring on the selected blanket fabric
? Non-toxic permanent fabric marker sets that remain after washing

The markers must be safe for children and suitable for sale in the European market. Please provide available safety and compliance documents, such as **CE marking where applicable, EN 71 test reports, REACH compliance, and any other relevant EU safety certificates or laboratory test reports**. Please do not send only photos of certificate logos; I need information about the actual available documents and which exact product/model they apply to.

At the first stage, I would like to order approximately **10 sample/test blankets**. Please send all information and quotations to me by private message.

Please include:

? Exact fabric composition for each blanket option
? Front fabric and back fabric details
? GSM/weight of each layer and total blanket weight
? Available sizes for children and adults
? Available colors for the back side
? Photos and videos of the fabric and finished blankets
? Whether the fabric has already been tested with washable markers
? Whether washable marker colors wash out completely and under what washing conditions
? Whether permanent fabric markers remain after repeated washing
? Whether marker ink can bleed through or transfer onto skin, clothes, beds or sofas
? Price for 10 plain white blankets without any printed design
? Price for 10 blankets printed with my own black-and-white artwork
? Any printing setup fee or sample fee
? Whether the 10 blankets can include different sizes, different back colors and different custom designs
? Price of washable marker sets
? Price of permanent fabric marker sets
? Number of colors included in each marker set
? Safety certificates and EU compliance documents for the blankets, printed materials and markers
? Production time for samples and future bulk orders
? MOQ for future orders
? Shipping cost and estimated delivery time
? Total estimated cost, including all available charges

Please provide separate quotations for:

**Option A:** Plain white-front blankets without custom printing
**Option B:** Blankets printed with my own black-and-white designs
**Option C:** Printed blankets + washable marker sets
**Option D:** Printed blankets + permanent fabric marker sets

If the quality, safety, pricing and test results are good, I am interested in long-term cooperation and larger future orders.

Thank you. I look forward to receiving detailed offers by private message.
